text:
maria (PM): quick thread to lock down admission heuristics for reserved pools before sprint planning. aim: predictable behavior + explainability.

jon (Eng-Platform): propose compact rule set: 1) explicit_guarantee flag wins, 2) SLA tier weight, 3) recent burn_score, 4) burst_window flag. keep checks bitwise and cached.

deepa (SRE): add protective measures: per-pool preempt budget and a cooldown if p99 or error-rate spikes. also a circuit that disables opportunistic admits when overloaded.

alice (Customer Success): customers want a clear UX: when requests are queued/denied show reason (quota, preemptable, pool-full) + suggested remediation (upgrade, reserve).

jon (Eng-Platform): runtime sketch: cache tenant_flags (5s), evaluate short-circuit: explicit_guarantee -> admit if capacity; else compute priority_score = sla_weight*10 - burn_score + burst_bonus; if score>threshold admit or mark preemptable.

maria (PM): policy outputs must be one of: ADMIT, QUEUE, PREEMPTABLE; reasons must be machine-readable strings for Console.

deepa (SRE): metrics for rollout: canary pool p99 change <=5%, preempt events per-tenant <= 3/day for alpha, overall preempt rate < 0.5% of requests.

ops-bot: NOTE: simulated load job queued 1756604330 for canary validation.

alice (Customer Success): also request a self-serve toggle for "guaranteed" in onboarding flow for enterprise customers.

maria (PM): action items: jon -> implement cache + evaluator prototype; deepa -> define circuit-break thresholds and alerting; alice -> UX copy for reason codes and onboarding toggle; i'll assemble rollout checklist. target: canary validation mid-week. :calendar:
